title: JSON hexadecimal decode and prefix validation

scope.rationale: jsonHexToInt, jsonHexToInt4, jsonIs2Hex, jsonIs4Hex, and jsonIs4HexB form the allocation-free ASCII hexadecimal primitive used by JSON string escape parsing. Together they preserve the distinction between caller-validated nibble decoding, explicit two/four-digit validation, and success-only JSONB operation mutation.
excluded_responsibilities: Unicode surrogate pairing and UTF-8 encoding
JSON text tokenization and malformed-input positions

external_source_responsibilities: Callers validate escape digits before invoking the permissive nibble decoder
dependencies.caller_closure: All five complete source bodies are assigned. jsonUnescapeOneChar consumes the four-digit and nibble decoders; JSON text parsing owns malformed escape validation and the JSONB text-operation transition.

inputs: One byte for nibble decoding, or fixed two/four-byte ASCII prefixes
outputs: Low hexadecimal nibble, packed four-digit u32, exact prefix-validity boolean, or success-only JSONB text operation update
contracts.ownership: Pure borrowed fixed-size inputs; no state mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: Nibble decode intentionally gives defined low-nibble behavior without asserting on nonhex input, matching source caller-precondition semantics. Prefix functions classify all required bytes.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks, callbacks, allocation, or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible fixed-size operations. Invalid prefixes return false; nibble validity remains a caller precondition.

representation_differences: The two-byte helper accepts a bounded slice with an explicit length assertion so runtime-index parser slices retain the source two-accessible-byte precondition; four-byte callers use fixed arrays where available.
Boolean results replace source int 0/1 values.

oracle.protocol: Decode boundary and mixed-case validated digits, pack a mixed-case four-digit value, validate true/false two- and four-byte prefixes, and require failed u-escape recognition to preserve the operation while success sets JSON text. Existing JSON escape execution covers production unescape callers.
internal_observations: JSONB operation before and after failed/successful u-escape recognition
oracle.normalization: Compare exact integer and boolean values.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Pure operations with no I/O or shared state.
assurance.malformed_input: Prefix validators reject malformed bytes; nibble decoder retains source caller-precondition behavior.

integration.native_call_path: unescapeOne uses hexToInt4 for Unicode escapes and hexToInt for JSON5 x escapes; TextParser.parseQuoted uses is4HexEscape and is2Hex for u/x escape validation and operation selection; registered JSON SQL functions consume the JSON parser.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The duplicate private hex arithmetic helper is retired.
